ENDPOINT.one_line: mRNA (nucleic-acid) delivery: luciferase/Cre mRNA LNPs given IV to mice, read out as mRNA-barcode deep-sequencing counts for the pooled screen and as IVIS luciferase luminescence / tdTomato recombination for the single-LNP validation. This IS a nucleic-acid delivery endpoint, so the extraction proceeds.
ENDPOINT.organ_qualifier_in_title: 'to the Brain' - the endpoint qualifier is the ORGAN, and brain is not currently an organ the in-vivo corpus is rich in. Secondary endpoint is REDUCED liver transfection.

value_panels.quantity: Formulation: ionizable-lipid identity and molar ratio IL / DOPE / Chol / C14-PEG2k for each of the b-LNP library members, plus three benchmark formulations with their own excipient sets
value_panels.why_not_tier_1_2_3: Tiers 1 and 3 do not exist for this article (above). This IS an SI table, but it is an SI table inside the SI PDF with no separate machine-readable file, so it is recorded at tier 4 (pdfplumber text) rather than tier 2, and read with pdfplumber.find_tables() which reports a real native 33x6 / 39x6 / 26x6 grid on these pages.
value_panels.role: FORMULATION, not a delivery value. Needed to define what each b-LNP number means.

value_panels.quantity: Size (nm), PDI, encapsulation efficiency (%), mRNA concentration (ng/uL) per b-LNP
value_panels.role: PHYSICOCHEMICAL CHARACTERISATION. Explicitly NOT delivery. data/'s Experiment_method vocabulary is delivery-only; size/PDI/EE are the exact panel types a sibling curation correctly ruled inadmissible. Extracted because it carries the paper's own inclusion criteria, which are what make the pool membership recoverable.

value_panels.quantity: Coefficients of variation (%) for the in-vivo single-LNP validation data of main-article Figure 3C-3H, for b-LNPs 13, 14, 70, 96, 97, 98, 45, 102
value_panels.role: NOT a delivery value - a CV carries no mean. Its real value is that it NAMES the single-LNP validation cohort exactly, which is how the admissible subset was identified at all, and that it would VERIFY any digitisation of Figure 3 (CV = SD/mean is a dimensionless check immune to axis-calibration error).

value_panels.quantity: Coefficients of variation (%) for flow-cytometry data of main-article Figure 4A-4D, for PBS, 13, 14, 97, 45, 102
value_panels.role: Same as Table S3. Names the flow cohort (6 groups incl. PBS).

value_panels.quantity: The mRNA-barcode pooled screen (normalised delivery per b-LNP per organ) AND the single-LNP validation luminescence (Fig 3C-3H)
value_panels.why: Main article PDF not acquired - ACS Cloudflare, shared browser forbidden, bot-check probe refused. See ACQUISITION_STATE.
value_panels.consequence: No value from the pooled screen and no value from Figure 3 is extracted in this curation. This is the binding constraint on the whole extraction, not a judgement about admissibility.

value_panels.panel: SI Figures S1, S2, S5, S7, S8, S9
value_panels.quantity: S1 = luminescence and DiR as % of total organ signal; S2 = RAW luminescence and DiR per organ; S5 = brain luminescence and DiR at 24 h (PBS-subtracted relative total flux); S7 = anti-luciferase MFI by brain cell type; S8 = cell viability; S9 = tdTomato Cre recombination in brain
value_panels.why_tiers_1_to_4_failed: Tier 1 and 3 do not exist for this article. Tier 2/4 fail for a checkable reason I measured: SI pages 13-21 carry page.get_drawings() == 0 and exactly ONE embedded raster image each, so there is no vector geometry and no text layer inside any SI figure - the numbers are not present in the file in any symbolic form.

native_dpi_measured.method: image pixel width / image bbox width in pt * 72, from PyMuPDF get_image_info(xrefs=True)

value_panels.status: NOT DIGITISED IN THIS CURATION - see DECISIONS.md D-2 and D-3. S2A was the one candidate admissible delivery panel; the reason it was not emitted is recorded there and in 07_qc.json, and it is a refusal, not an omission.

structure_sources.locus: SI 'Ionizable Lipid Synthesis', pp. 2-4: a FULL systematic IUPAC name for every one of the 15 lipids, each with the amine-core mass/mmol/equivalents and the epoxide mass/mmol/equivalents.
structure_sources.why_this_is_strong: The structures are NOT digitised and NOT inferred from a drawing. They are parsed from the authors' own systematic names, and then the amine core is independently pinned by the paper's own stoichiometry (see 07_qc.json check P1): amine mg/mmol reproduces the derived free-base MW to <=0.16% for all five cores once the true mmol is recovered from the printed epoxide equivalents.

what_is_NOT_in_this_curation: Any value from the pooled mRNA-barcode screen (main article; unavailable AND see D-1 on admissibility).
Any digitised SI figure value (refused - D-2, D-3).
Any merge into data/ (out of scope by instruction).
